blocks.text: As members of The Redeemed Christian Church of God, these are our shared visions and goals:

items: To take as many people as possible with us.
To have a member of the Redeemed Christian Church of God in every family of all nations.
To accomplish the first goal above, holiness will be our lifestyle.

To accomplish the second and third goals above, we will plant churches within five minutes' walking distance in every city and town of developing countries, and within five minutes' driving distance in every city and town of developed countries.

blocks.text: We will pursue these objectives until every nation in the world is reached for Jesus Christ our Lord.
